suspects.name: Miming
suspects.voice_notes: tsismosa neighborhood-aunt energy, says 'Naku!' and 'Ay grabe!', whispers 'wag mo sabihin kahit kanino ha' before sharing, tail flicks when excited

suspects.name: Whitey
suspects.voice_notes: acts like he owns the whole barangay, calls the player 'my dear detective', sniffs 'Hmp' when doubted, grooms his spotless fur when he feels cornered

suspects.name: Choco
suspects.voice_notes: over-explains, stammers 'ah, eh, kasi...', babbles when worried, kneads the air when anxious

suspects.name: Blackie
suspects.voice_notes: short sentences, often answers a question with a question, stares without blinking, only drops a Tagalog word when it matters

suspects.name: Pandesal
suspects.voice_notes: warm and friendly, calls the player 'ate' or 'kuya', purrs mid-sentence, loses their train of thought, gets distracted by anything that smells like bread

suspects.name: Tigre
suspects.voice_notes: blunt barangay-tanod energy, patrols the alley, complains about everything, hisses at the word 'ligo' (bath)
